newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes 0.34 lower at 999.02.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes 0.34 lower at 999.02.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 0.34 lower at 999.02 in quiet trading on the country's interbank market that saw the central bank intervene by buying dollars to keep the local currency within its daily floating rate exchange band.
"We think the bank bought between $40 and $50 million," one trade said in a telephone interview.
Apart from the bank, which refrains from commenting on its interventions in the foreign exchange market, traders said there was no real demand for U.S. currency.

The central bank has fallen under growing pressure to devalue the peso, which has strengthened sharply since June, to help shore up Colombia's export sector and increase the real peso value of export revenues.
Dealers reported 110 trades in Friday's session for a total of $137 million and said the peso held in a narrow 999.10 to 999 trading range.
